# netbox_circuit_group_assignment (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/circuits/circuitgroupassignment/):

> A circuit group assignment places a circuit, or a virtual circuit, in a circuit group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_circuit_group_assignment" "example" {
  group_id    = netbox_circuit_group.example.id
  member_type = "circuits.circuit"
  member_id   = netbox_circuit.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) The ID of the group associated with the circuit group assignment.
- `member_id` (Number) The ID of the member associated with the circuit group assignment.
- `member_type` (String) The member type of the circuit group assignment.

### Optional

- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `priority` (String) One of [primary, secondary, tertiary, inactive].
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the circuit group assignment was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the circuit group assignment was last changed.
- `member` (String) The member of the circuit group assignment.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_circuit_group_assignment.example 1
```
